name: cli-conversational-surface
title: CLI as Conversational Surface
description: Make every scenario's CLI a first-class conversational surface alongside proto tools. Adds a structured `introspect` command to the shared cli-core package so every scenario CLI automatically emits a machine-readable command tree (names, flags, descriptions, examples) while preserving the default human output contract. Agent-inbox discovers and indexes CLI commands at startup, invokes them via shell with captured human output, and treats them as synchronous by default. Scenarios can later `upgrade` a CLI command to a proto tool when richer metadata (async, approval, idempotency) is warranted. Auditor rule enforces that every scenario CLI responds to `introspect`. This is what makes every scenario conversationally usable from day one without requiring each to implement proto tools.
